name: Haus Bergheim
beschreibung:
Quietly located in the pedestrian-friendly village of Serfaus, Haus Bergheim welcomes guests with cosy rooms and personal care. It is a wonderful home base for mountain-loving families.

The village underground stations, Serfaus-Fiss-Ladis cable cars, and scenic trails are quickly reached.
kurzbeschreibung: Haus Bergheim in Serfaus offers warm family hospitality on the sunny high-altitude plateau.
